topics.description: Minnesota's handling of Medicaid fraud allegations has come under scrutiny, with Gov. Tim Walz and AG Keith Ellison testifying in a congressional hearing. The state's program was criticized for potential fraud and abuse.
topics.reason: High-profile testimony and allegations of mishandling

topics.description: The Feeding Our Future program in Minnesota has been embroiled in a fraud scandal, with allegations of misuse of funds and improper handling of the program.
topics.reason: Ongoing investigation and recent sentencing of individuals involved
